著.meaning: traditional form of 着; aspect particle (-ing); marks ongoing action or state
著.sentence_pinyin: tā zhèng kàn zhe nà běn shū ne
著.sentence_english: He is looking at that book.

为.meaning: why; for; because of; as in 为什么
为.sentence_pinyin: nǐ wèi shén me xué xí zhōng wén

染.meaning: to infect; to spread; to dye or stain; as in 传染
染.sentence: 他感冒了，会传染给别人。
染.sentence_pinyin: tā gǎn mào le, huì chuán rǎn gěi bié rén
染.sentence_english: He has a cold and can spread it to other people.

微.meaning: slight; tiny; as in 微辣
微.sentence: 这道菜微辣，但是不太辣。
微.sentence_pinyin: zhè dào cài wēi là, dàn shì bù tài là
微.sentence_english: This dish is mildly spicy, but not too spicy.

挽.sentence_pinyin: tā wǎn zhe mā ma de gē bo
挽.sentence_english: She is holding her mother's arm.

算.meaning: to calculate; to reckon/figure; as in 打算: to plan or intend
算.sentence_pinyin: wǒ dǎ suàn zhōu mò zài jiā xiū xi
算.sentence_english: I plan to rest at home this weekend.

敏.meaning: quick/sharp; as in 敏感: sensitive
敏.sentence_pinyin: wǒ duì huā fěn yǒu diǎn mǐn gǎn
敏.sentence_english: I'm a bit sensitive to pollen.

戏.meaning: play/drama; as in 游戏: game
戏.sentence: 《英雄联盟》是我最喜欢的游戏。
戏.sentence_pinyin: yīng xióng lián méng shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de yóu xì
戏.sentence_english: League of Legends is my favorite game.

该.meaning: should; ought to; as in 应该
该.sentence_pinyin: wǒ yīng gāi zǎo diǎn shuì jiào
该.sentence_english: I should go to sleep earlier.

者.meaning: person/one who; as in 或者: or/perhaps
者.sentence: 晚上我们可以出去吃饭，或者在家做饭。
者.sentence_pinyin: wǎn shang wǒ men kě yǐ chū qù chī fàn, huò zhě zài jiā zuò fàn
者.sentence_english: Tonight we can eat out, or cook at home.

交.meaning: to hand in/pay; to make friends; to exchange/interact; as in 交作业 or 交朋友
交.sentence_pinyin: wǒ míng tiān yào jiāo zuò yè
交.sentence_english: I need to hand in my homework tomorrow.

童.meaning: child; as in 童话: fairy tale
童.sentence: 我小时候很喜欢听童话故事。
童.sentence_pinyin: wǒ xiǎo shí hou hěn xǐ huan tīng tóng huà gù shì
童.sentence_english: When I was little, I really liked listening to fairy tales.

计.meaning: to calculate; to plan; as in 计划
计.sentence_pinyin: wǒ míng tiān méi yǒu shén me jì huà
计.sentence_english: I don't have many plans tomorrow.

而.meaning: and; moreover; as in 而且
而.sentence: 这家店便宜，而且很好吃。
而.sentence_pinyin: zhè jiā diàn pián yi, ér qiě hěn hǎo chī
而.sentence_english: This place is cheap, and also really tasty.

专.meaning: specialized; focused; as in 专家: expert/specialist
专.sentence_pinyin: tā shì zhè fāng miàn de zhuān jiā
专.sentence_english: He is an expert in this area.

隐.meaning: hidden; invisible; as in 隐形眼镜: contact lenses
隐.sentence_pinyin: wǒ píng shí dài yǐn xíng yǎn jìng

如.meaning: as; if; as in 如果: if
如.sentence: 如果你有空，给我打电话。
如.sentence_pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ yǒu kòng, gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
如.sentence_english: If you're free, give me a call.

程.meaning: process; program/course; as in 编程: programming or 工程师: engineer
程.sentence: 我是软件工程师，平时喜欢编程。
程.sentence_pinyin: wǒ shì ruǎn jiàn gōng chéng shī, píng shí xǐ huan biān chéng
程.sentence_english: I'm a software engineer, and I usually like programming.
